title: 94 Dushanbe 259: Tajik Air Pilots Report Unidentified Flying Object
doc_notes: This document is a Department of State cable from the U.S. Embassy in Dushanbe reporting a UFO sighting by Tajik Air pilots over Kazakhstan in 1994.

incidents.summary: Tajik Air pilots flying a Boeing 747SP over Kazakhstan observed a high-speed, highly maneuverable light source at high altitude for approximately 40 minutes.
incidents.explanation: The crew rejected the possibility of a meteor; they believed it was extraterrestrial and under intelligent control.
incidents.quote: THEY FIRST ENCOUNTERED THE OBJECT AS A BRIGHT LIGHT OF ENORMOUS INTENSITY
